t: 前一个月教皇史蒂芬二世去世后当选教皇保罗一世.
te: Election of pope Paul I following the death of pope Stephen II in the previous month.
dz: 前一个月教皇史蒂芬二世去世后当选教皇保罗一世.
de: Election of pope Paul I following the death of pope Stephen II in the previous month.

dz: 诗人杜甫在安禄山之乱期间逃离长安后，以唐玄宗宫廷成员的身份返回长安。
de: The poet Du Fu returns to Chang'an as a member of Emperor Xuanzong's court, after having escaped the city during the An Lushan Rebellion.
